Senses.Explanation: Having no handle to grasp renders the image literally as having no nose-handle: no projecting part by which a thing can be seized or led. The frozen corpus has 197 exact hits in 93 files representing 91 works. Chan records apply it to sayings, circumstances, people, and what a listener confronts. Dahui pairs it with ‘no flavor’ and says there is nothing to grasp when considering the dry shit-stick or a raised saying. Another record reverses the phrase into a direction for inquiry: investigate until there is no handle, and precisely there is a good place to investigate. Wuzhun plays the positive and negative forms against each other. The repeated bend is the point at which a word or encounter supplies no graspable lead.
